name: Amazon Web Services: EC2 and SageMaker AI
training_mode: GPU virtual machines, managed training jobs, distributed clusters and Trainium training
accelerator: NVIDIA GPUs; AWS Trainium; selected Gaudi instances
offer_notes: New accounts receive $100, potentially another $100 through activities. Studio Lab accepts existing customers only.
interface: AWS APIs, SDKs, CLI; EC2 lifecycle and SageMaker managed jobs
limits: Free-plan service restrictions, CPU-only published EC2 eligible sizes, quota, region, credit expiry and storage charges; GPU-credit eligibility requires verification.

name: Microsoft Azure: GPU VMs and Azure Machine Learning
training_mode: GPU virtual machines and managed model training
accelerator: NVIDIA NC/ND families; selected AMD configurations
offer_notes: Eligible new accounts receive $200 for 30 days; no recurring free GPU allocation established.
interface: Azure resource APIs, SDKs, CLI and managed training jobs
limits: GPU SKU entitlement, quota, region and credit eligibility require verification; paid upgrade enables uncovered charges.

name: Google Cloud: Compute Engine, managed training and Cloud TPU
training_mode: GPU virtual machines, managed serverless training and TPU training
accelerator: NVIDIA GPUs; Google Cloud TPUs
offer_notes: $300 welcome credit lasts 90 days. Nonbillable trial accounts cannot attach VM GPUs; paid billing activation retains unexpired credit.
interface: Google Cloud APIs, SDKs and CLI; managed training jobs and VM lifecycle
limits: Paid activation enables uncovered charges; GPU quota and capacity remain separate. Existing Google vendor relationship through Colab Enterprise.

name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure: GPU Compute and Data Science
training_mode: GPU VMs, bare-metal clusters and model development
accelerator: NVIDIA GPUs; AMD Instinct GPUs; free CPU-only AMD and Arm shapes
offer_notes: Always Free Arm compute equals 2 OCPUs/12 GB; eligible trial grants $300 for 30 days. No Always Free GPU.
interface: OCI APIs, SDKs, CLI and VM lifecycle
limits: Home-region capacity restrictions; trial GPU eligibility unverified; GPU compute, storage and networking require separate cost checks.

name: Alibaba Cloud: ACS GPU, PAI and GPU ECS
training_mode: Serverless GPU training, GPU VMs and managed model training
accelerator: Product-specific GPUs
offer_notes: General trials cover many products; exact GPU product-card eligibility must be confirmed. No universal recurring free GPU allocation established.
interface: Cloud APIs, SDKs and container or VM execution
limits: Region, account eligibility, exact trial SKU, expiry, storage and transfer charges require verification.

name: Tencent Cloud: GPU Cloud and Cloud Studio
training_mode: GPU virtual machines and notebook/development environments
accelerator: Configuration-specific GPUs; CPU options
offer_notes: Chinese Cloud Studio page advertises check-in rewards totaling up to two machine-hours across eligible CPU/GPU configurations; GPU Cloud is paid.
interface: GPU cloud resources and hosted development environment; exact external automation requires validation
limits: Promotional, account, geography and SKU conditions; not two guaranteed GPU-hours daily for everyone.

name: Huawei Cloud: ModelArts and CodeLab
training_mode: Notebooks, SSH development and distributed training jobs
accelerator: Regional GPU or Ascend configurations; CPU options
offer_notes: Chinese CodeLab docs describe renewable one-hour free GPU sessions; current international ModelArts documentation describes metered training and OBS.
interface: ModelArts managed training, notebooks and documented SSH development
limits: Real-name authentication, region and resource capacity; no global free entitlement established; storage may be billed and inactivity deletes CodeLab files.

name: IBM Cloud: GPU and accelerator servers
training_mode: GPU or AI accelerator virtual servers
accelerator: NVIDIA A100/L40S; Intel Gaudi 3
offer_notes: Current signup guide describes $200 credit for 30 days on a card-verified Pay-As-You-Go account; Lite services do not establish GPU entitlement.
interface: IBM Cloud VPC infrastructure and server lifecycle
limits: Exact credit eligibility, accelerator capacity, paid account charges and ancillary costs require verification.

name: Hetzner: GEX dedicated GPU servers
training_mode: Dedicated single-GPU or multi-GPU training servers
accelerator: NVIDIA RTX PRO Blackwell configurations
offer_notes: Paid hourly/monthly dedicated servers, potentially with setup fees; current lineup includes four-GPU GEX430.
interface: Dedicated server with user-controlled OS and CUDA training software
limits: Inventory, location, exact order configuration and setup fees; older single-GPU FAQ conflicts with newer multi-GPU product card.

name: IONOS Cloud: GPU VMs
training_mode: Dedicated GPU virtual machines for model training
accelerator: NVIDIA H200
offer_notes: Paid GPU VM product; no recurring free GPU allocation established.
interface: Documented Cloud API operations and SDKs
limits: Predefined templates, required privileges, available host capacity and separately planned storage.

name: Exoscale: GPU compute instances
training_mode: GPU instances for training, simulation and rendering
accelerator: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell; up to eight GPUs per instance
offer_notes: Paid GPU instances; no recurring free GPU allocation established.
interface: Cloud instance provisioning; API, CLI and SDK documentation linked by provider
limits: Manual account screening prioritizes established businesses; current region/currency pricing requires live quote because public price fields are dynamic.

name: Gcore: GPU Cloud
training_mode: Virtual or bare-metal GPU training and clusters
accelerator: NVIDIA A100, H100, H200, L40S and newer product-specific configurations
offer_notes: Paid on-demand or reserved GPU compute; no verified recurring free GPU allowance.
interface: Training environments and documented API provisioning
limits: Node versus per-GPU pricing, VAT, stop/delete billing semantics and persistent storage costs differ by resource.

name: UpCloud: GPU Servers
training_mode: Dedicated-device GPU servers, fine-tuning and multi-GPU training
accelerator: NVIDIA L4, L40S, H100, B200 and configuration-dependent newer GPUs
offer_notes: Paid hourly GPU servers with spot/reserved options; no recurring free GPU allowance established.
interface: Control panel or API; CUDA Ubuntu template
limits: Account capacity, selected GPU availability and hourly billing; coming-soon hardware must not be counted as currently rentable.

name: Civo: GPU Compute and Kubernetes
training_mode: GPU compute and Kubernetes for model training
accelerator: NVIDIA A100, L40S, H100, H200 and Blackwell configurations
offer_notes: Pricing advertises $250 new-user credit for the first month; GPU credit eligibility remains unconfirmed.
interface: Documented GPU deployment through dashboard or CLI
limits: Account credit conditions and capacity; commitment prices must not be labeled on-demand prices; other cloud resources remain billable.

name: ACCESS research and education allocations
training_mode: Approved research or education on allocated GPU/CPU clusters and clouds
accelerator: Host-specific GPUs and CPU resources
offer_notes: No-cost approved allocations; not an unrestricted public GPU rental service.
interface: Host-specific Slurm, Open OnDemand, cloud or other authorized interfaces
limits: Eligible organizational affiliation/email, generally U.S.-based project lead, approved collaboration and research purpose; unaffiliated users ineligible.

name: NSF NAIRR Pilot
training_mode: Approved AI research/education on contributed training systems and commercial clouds
accelerator: Award-specific GPUs, accelerators and CPU resources
offer_notes: Application-based resources; underlying systems overlap ACCESS, CloudBank and individual host listings.
interface: Approved host or cloud account interfaces, not one universal compute API
limits: U.S.-based institutional eligibility and resource-specific rules; institutional email required; not every partner resource supports training.

name: CloudBank sponsored cloud allocations
training_mode: Award-funded training on approved commercial cloud services
accelerator: Approved AWS, Google Cloud, IBM or Azure resources
offer_notes: NSF-sponsored access through ACCESS/NAIRR awards; not another underlying cloud vendor or an independent duplicate allocation.
interface: Federated account access and individual cloud interfaces
limits: Approved award, eligible services and remaining balance; email balance alerts do not alone establish zero-spend enforcement.

name: Jetstream2, NCSA Delta and DeltaAI allocation hosts
training_mode: Allocated GPU training VMs or Slurm jobs on concrete research hosts
accelerator: Host-specific A100, A40, H200, H100 and AMD resources
offer_notes: Concrete systems accessed through overlapping ACCESS, NAIRR or institutional awards; count awarded resources once.
interface: Host-specific VM interfaces; Delta Slurm, SSH with MFA and Open OnDemand
limits: Valid allocation, host authorization, queue and wall-time limits, MFA, storage retention and approved purpose.

name: EuroHPC AI Factories allocations
training_mode: Allocated supercomputing for AI training and research
accelerator: Host-specific GPU supercomputers
offer_notes: Eligible AI SMEs/startups and qualifying research can receive free access; other industrial applications can use paid commercial access.
interface: Hosting AI Factory scheduler and authorized execution interfaces
limits: Eligibility and technical assessment, proposal, host capacity and awarded duration; Playground, Fast Lane and Large Scale requirements differ.

name: Google TPU Research Cloud
training_mode: Approved open-research training on Cloud TPUs
accelerator: Google Cloud TPU; not NVIDIA CUDA GPUs
offer_notes: Accepted researchers receive no-charge TPU access and are expected to share supported research and feedback.
interface: Cloud TPU environments with TPU-compatible JAX, TensorFlow or PyTorch-XLA recipes
limits: Application acceptance, open-research expectations and allocation capacity; arbitrary CUDA scripts require adaptation.

name: NVIDIA Academic Grant Program: paused applications
training_mode: Competitive academic training compute or hardware awards when applications reopen
accelerator: Program-specific NVIDIA GPU cloud hours or hardware
offer_notes: Current official page says not accepting new applications despite legacy call cards and Apply Now links.
interface: Award-specific NVIDIA cloud or supplied hardware
limits: Not an active public signup; competitive faculty eligibility, required technologies, proposal and award conditions.
